purpose: Publish the account inbox relay list when owned by Few, and rebuild and rotate discoverability to the newly configured relays.

public_api.name: ensureInboxRelayList
public_api.description: Read latest own 10050 on the current and optional previous relay set. Do not overwrite a foreign list or a partial lookup. Sign only the configured relay tags and Few client tag.

public_api.name: rebuildAccountForRelays
public_api.description: Tear down the old session before bootstrapping with new defaults and rotating the active key packages in the replacement session.

dependencies_allowed: public library keyPackages API and event signer
